name: World of Pannotia: More Mob Heads
summary: Almost every mob can drop its own decorative head when killed by a player. Heads are custom-skinned player heads that match the mob variant (colour, biome type, profession, and so on). Chances are low for common mobs and higher or guaranteed for bosses and rare mobs; Looting raises them.

new_content.name: Mob heads (about 250 variants)
new_content.how_to_obtain: Kill the mob as a player (the killed-by-player condition is required). Each head is a player head with a texture and a name such as "Bat Head". Placed on a note block it plays the mob sound; it can also be worn or placed as decoration.
new_content.notes: Heads keep their data when broken (see Vanilla Loot Overrides). Textures credited to MoreMobHeads by JoelGodOfwar and minecraft-heads.com.

mechanics.title: Chance formula
mechanics.description: Each head pool needs killed-by-player. Chances use a Looting-based bonus: the listed base chance without Looting, the "L1" chance at Looting I, then the stated increase per level above I. Entries marked "always" have no chance roll.

mechanics.title: Sheep heads
mechanics.description: A player-killed unsheared sheep can drop the head of its colour: 1.75% (L1 2%, +0.25% per level above I), 16 colours. Also, the sheep table references a "jeb_ Sheep Head" table that has no name check, so every player-killed sheep has a 10% chance (L1 15%, +5% per level above I) of also dropping the jeb_ Sheep Head. A name-gated version (jeb_sheep.json, requires the sheep to be named "jeb_") exists but is not referenced.

mechanics.title: Tropical fish
mechanics.description: more_mob_heads defines a generic Tropical Fish Head, but minecraft:entities/tropical_fish does not reference it; the pannotia module supplies the tropical fish heads instead.

mechanics.title: Special cases
mechanics.description: Charged creepers drop the Charged Creeper Head (100%); regular creepers use the pannotia module. A rabbit named "Toast" always drops the Toast Rabbit Head. Strider heads are chosen 50/50 between normal and cold, regardless of the actual strider. Villager heads depend on profession; zombie villagers have their own set.

vanilla_changes.change: Roughly 90 mobs gain an additional player-head pool (see the per-mob list). Vanilla drops are unchanged.

getting_started: Kill mobs, ideally with Looting. Guaranteed heads: wandering trader, warden, elder guardian, wither, camel, camel husk, sniffer, zombie horse, villager.
editor_notes: The jeb_ sheep behavior looks like a bug; verify in game. Several entries rely on entity NBT predicates (bee, goat, panda, villager, trader llama, copper golem, wolf anger) that may not match reliably in 26.2; verify in game. The nautilus drop is a player head named "Nautilus Shell", not the item.
